text_block_list.text:
I drop by the library to look for some
materials,
only to find Meisho Doto with
a friend.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do I have any hope for salvation?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well... The divine messages of the great
Shiraoki
are absolute! No result can be
undone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep, T-Trainer! Well, you see,
Fukukitaru is
reading fortunes right now..
choice_data_list: You've got a pretty troubled look on your face.
You've got a pretty troubled look on your face, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! It appears that a fan from abroad
has
concerns about pursuing the path of
an artist.
They've come seeking advice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Shiraoki has brought me
a
warning. That same path comes with
great
difficulty—failure is very much a
possibility!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh no... that's quite harsh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However... I trust the results of this
divination will
illuminate a path!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please, translate this for me! It's due
time to put
your language skills to work!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be p-possible to ask someone
else to
do the translation instead?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how best to put it... I don't
want to
hurt their feelings in any way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I agree with this sentiment! Should you
be
wishy-washy, it could invite unwanted
misfortune!
choice_data_list: I think you should just be honest with them.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You t-two are right. I'm so, so very sorry
for
casting doubt on your
fortune-telling... Uugh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, I'll do the translation! Be
honest... be
honest!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, well... maybe I... No, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nngh... If this is p-possible, and only if...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I w-would like to include this proverb...
or maybe
not...

Meisho Doto has written down a phrase
in
English...

"Every failure is a stepping stone to
success."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: How do you say that—fail... fail...ure? What could this possibly mean?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, translated back into Japanese, it
means,
"Failure is where success begins."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And, if I follow it up with, "I'm cheering
you on in
all of your endeavors," then
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! My parents would tell me this
whenever I
felt down because of my own
failures.
choice_data_list: Those words really give you courage.
Those words really give you courage, don't they.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I recite it in my head, in
hopes that just
maybe all my many
failures will lead me to
something great!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, b-but you don't have to include it! I
wouldn't
want the fortune-telling to get
messed up
b-b-because of my
suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Quite the contrary! I sense a lot of lucky
power
emanating from these words. We
shall include
that English line!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Are you s-sure? I'm actually starting to
think it...
sounds kind of preachy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's what you think, Trainer...
th-then,
I'll go ahead with it.
choice_data_list: Maybe you should soften your phrasing a bit...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's send our response
straightaway!
Hehe, the great Shiraoki is
going international! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, they replied! Give us the
translation!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see... "Thank you. I'll take on
the
challenge without worrying about
failure!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Looks like the proverb really
packs a lot of
power!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It r-really does!

Meisho Doto looks happy to see the
requester
respond so positively.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right on that... Um, what would
that look
like?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What about expanding on the
explanation? We
could introduce a
divine message from Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That... could work. Also, it might be
good to add
a preface, or... annotations!

All these new additions result in a
decently sized
stack of papers rivaling
the length of a short
story.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: D-do you think they'll read all of this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If they do, I can't imagine they would
understand
the primary message of the
fortune...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, no! I have to try and fix it up!

With a couple more tweaks, Meisho
Doto whittles
it down to a perfectly
understandable paragraph.
